# Studio Vibhor Sogani

> Artist portfolio featuring public art, sculpture, light installations, and a press archive.

## Pages
- [Studio Vibhor Sogani — Monumental Public Art & Contemporary Installations](https://vibhorsogani.com/): Explore monumental public art, spatial lighting installations, and contemporary sculptures by Indian artist Vibhor Sogani.
- [About Vibhor Sogani — Philosophy, Mastery & Monumental Practice](https://vibhorsogani.com/about): Learn about artist Vibhor Sogani's trajectory, materials mastery in stainless steel and light, studio ethos, and global landmarks.
- [Sculptural Works & Public Installations — Studio Vibhor Sogani](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations): Curated collection of 38+ site-specific public monuments, light sculptures, and architectural installations worldwide.
- [Press, Editorials & Media Coverage — Studio Vibhor Sogani](https://vibhorsogani.com/press): Archival record of publications, global design editorials, architectural magazines, and broadsheet features covering Vibhor Sogani.
- [Contact & Commissions — Studio Vibhor Sogani](https://vibhorsogani.com/contact): Direct inquiries for site-specific public commissions, bespoke architectural lighting, and monumental masterplanning.
- [Privacy Policy — Studio Vibhor Sogani](https://vibhorsogani.com/privacy-policy): Studio Vibhor Sogani privacy policies, communication data protection, and terms.
- [Terms & Conditions — Studio Vibhor Sogani](https://vibhorsogani.com/terms): Studio Vibhor Sogani terms of service and commission agreements.
- [Sprouts](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/sprouts): Standing 40 feet tall and spread across 6 acres of green space around the AIIMS flyover in the heart of Delhi, Sprouts is India's largest site-specific public art installation...
- [PM Vishwakarma Installation](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/pm-vishwakarma-installation): Installed at Yashobhoomi — the India International Convention and Expo Centre in Dwarka — this piece was commissioned as an aesthetic centrepiece for the venue's launch...
- [Bodhi Tree](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/bodhi-tree): Bodhi Tree is a nine-deck-high wishing-tree installation built into the elevator shafts of Royal Caribbean's Utopia of the Seas...
- [Sangam](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/sangam): Sangam stands in the Archaeological Experiential Museum at Vadnagar, Gujarat — a museum built at a cost of roughly ₹300 crore...
- [Joy](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/joy): Joy is a 30-foot-tall public art installation at Dubai Creek Harbour, commissioned as part of Art EMAAR's outdoor gallery initiative...
- [Pratibimb](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/pratibimb): Pratibimb — Hindi for "reflection" — is the third piece in Sogani's suite of works for the Vadnagar Archaeological Experiential Museum...
- [Mahatma](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/mahatma): Mahatma was executed with support of the Ministry of Culture, Government of India and the National Gallery of Modern Art, India for the PARI (Public Art Project of India) initiative.
- [Map Vadnagar](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/map-vadnagar): Also housed within the Vadnagar Archaeological Experiential Museum, this piece renders the historic city of Vadnagar as a physical map...
- [Kalpavriksha](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/kalpavriksha): Kalpavriksha, the wish fulfilling tree has been portrayed as a symbol of eternal love, immortality and fertility in sacred texts and scriptures. Standing 35 feet tall at Arvind Uplands in Ahmedabad, India, this light sculpture is crafted using mirror-finished steel balls. The installation comes alive at night with a dynamic glow.
- [Deepam](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/deepam): Inspired from the popular Indian festival of lights — Diwali, this light installation is composed of approximately 70 floating Deepams spread over 100m in the canal of Amsterdam. Made in brass, these handcrafted pieces feature controlled undulations that enhance and magnify the effect of the dancing amber flame inside. It invites viewers to partake in the spirit of Diwali and share its universal message of light and hope.
- [Peepal](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/peepal): Peepal is a site-specific installation located at the Tijara Fort Palace in Rajasthan, India. The space housing this installation has been named "Vibhor Mahal". It is inspired by the ancient Hindu reverence for the inverted banyan tree which has its roots upwards and branches down and whose leaves are Vedic hymns.
- [Through the Depths](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/through-the-depths): Through the Depths is an ode to the process of transformation. This installation symbolises the journey of raw stone, extracted from the depths, which is then refined and polished into a timeless treasure.
- [Tidal Tango](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/tidal-tango): "Tidal Tango" is a sculptural ode to the dynamic, yet symphonic, union of two waves. Crafted in mirror-finish Stainless steel, this piece distills the beauty of collision and convergence, inviting the viewer to contemplate the intersections of power, serenity, and the eternal ebb and flow of life.
- [Balancing Act](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/balancing-act): Balancing Act is a series that captures the essence of a tightrope walk, reflecting life's delicate interplay between balance and imbalance. The works feature undulating surfaces that create dynamic, shifting reflections, contrasted with crisp, almost flawless segments.
- [Pool of Dreams](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/pool-of-dreams): Pool of Dreams was created for the 12th edition of the Amsterdam Light Festival 2023. Now a part of the permanent portfolio of the Light Art Collection in Amsterdam, the installation features polished steel orbs that playfully rise from the water and spill onto the adjacent land. It has also been showcased in Aarhaus Festuge 2024, Denmark. (Photo credits: Janus Van Eijnden)
- [Kalpataru](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/kalpataru): Created for Project PARI, Kalpataru is a 20-foot tall light art installation accomplished with the support of the Ministry of Culture, Government of India and the National Gallery of Modern Art. Inspired by the sacred tree from ancient mythology, Kalpataru stands as a symbol of abundance, prosperity, and the fulfilment of desires. The luminous form reflects India's deep cultural roots while embodying its forward-looking spirit.
- [Shankha](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/shankha): Inspired by the 'Shankha' or conch shell, this piece encapsulates the essence of life and nature. In Hindu mythology, the Shankha signifies the beginning of any auspicious endeavour, its sound revered as the purest form that ushers in freshness and new hope. It symbolises purity, brilliance, and auspiciousness. The interior glows with a warm amber light.
- [Thus Life](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/thus-life): Thus Life, an Art Installation by Vibhor Sogani, embodies the evolutionary patterns found in ecological systems, where growth follows a definite rhythm, yet remains inherently fluid and dynamic. The form, inspired by bionics, draws from the principles of biology and natural science. Its curvature and flowing design evoke a sense of growth and progress.
- [Nebula](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/nebula): "In the world where we may not constantly be accompanied by another, the NEBULA is a reminder that we do not run solo; instead, we carry within many versions of our own selves — because, we are never just one person." — Vibhor Sogani. Nebula, a suspended sculpture made from mirror-finished stainless-steel spheres, invites viewers to reflect on the multi-layered nature of human experience. Created for Dubai Design Week.
- [Soldier, Saint, Poet](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/soldier-saint-poet): Soldier, Saint, Poet is a tribute to Guru Gobind Singh Ji. The art installation, made of brass and steel, was conceptualised by Arpana Caur and translated into form by Vibhor Sogani. It is located at Prakash Punj, Bihar, India.
- [Magical Bloom](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/magical-bloom): The light installation is made of countless polished stainless-steel orbs that come together to form the shape of a flower in full glory. Magical Bloom serves as a visual reminder of the boundless natural beauty around us. The reflective orbs interact with the environment, mirroring the ever-changing sky, people, and movements, creating a tapestry of sparkling, multi-layered reflections.
- [Rhythm](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/rhythm): "Music & Rhythm find their way into the secret places of our soul." In the performance arts, rhythm is the timing of events on a human scale; of musical sounds and silences that occur over time, of the steps of a dance, or the meter of unspoken language and poetry. The rhythm of life is felt when you experience your own body, mind, and soul together.
- [A Slice of Sky](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/a-slice-of-sky): A Slice of Sky takes the form of floating lotus petals. The soft metal curves gently, creating a space that sits harmoniously within the landscape. Mirror-finish droplets, like shimmering mercury, trickle down the satin surface and the mirrored water evokes a sense of serenity and wonder.
- [Aroma](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/aroma): The light installation serves as the centrepiece of a 50-foot-high reception atrium for a leading spice manufacturing company. Suspended from the ceiling, the 35-foot-tall piece features mirror-finished stainless steel balls and floating 'aroma rings' of light that spiral upward and expand.
- [Divine Walk](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/divine-walk): Divine Walk was showcased as part of Chitrakavyam Ramayanam, an exhibition at the National Gallery of Modern Art, India. The exhibition featured artistic interpretations of the Ramayana, with Divine Walk offering a visual narrative for this timeless epic.
- [Kink Within](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/kink-within): Kink Within refers in its design to a barren landscape, cracked and desolate. Even in these harsh terrains, small plants push through the ground. These resilient spurs symbolize the incredible spirit of living things. They adapt, thrive, and overcome obstacles.
- [Casa](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/casa): Casa, a light installation inspired from the "weaver's nest" is a tribute to home in the vast, natural world. Constructed with a blend of approximately 4500 SS mirror finished beads, it gives a sense of life within, with a warm glow. The ever changing, multiple reflections produce a visual texture that makes the cocoon form mesmerizing from all around.
- [Blue Grass](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/blue-grass): Blue Grass consists of a group of wavy stainless steel strands that undulate gracefully in a celebratory pattern. Each strand's diameter gradually decreases from bottom to top, creating gaps filled with gentle blue glow.
- [Life](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/life): Crafted from stainless steel and copper, Life is an installation that explores how the smallest challenges have the power to shape and bend the narrative of our lives.
- [The Hub](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/the-hub): The Hub illustrates an Institute's stature, reflecting its role in interpreting and disseminating knowledge. The mirror-finished steel orb suggests a core, concentrated with values and crucial data. The layered metal rings around the core rise to form an expanding network of information.
- [Confluence](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/confluence): Confluence, a Light Art installation, celebrates the relationship of space, science, and technology and the intricacies involved in its application for complex human advancement. The sculpture is reminiscent of a receptacle that facilitates the give-gather-give cycle of information.
- [Quartz](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/quartz): Quartz, an art installation.
- [Mahatma Gandhi](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/mahatma-gandhi): Mahatma Gandhi, Father of our nation. Location: Cabinet Room, New Delhi.
- [Rooted in Diversity](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/rooted-in-diversity): Rooted in Diversity — a celebration of unity within plurality.
- [Ensō](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/enso): Ensō is one of the deepest symbols in Japanese Zen — the revelation of a world of the spirit without beginning and end. The artwork is a circle made of stainless steel spheres. It represents a fleeting moment when mind releases its grip and body is able to create freely.
- [In Deep Thought](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/in-deep-thought): In Deep Thought — Mahatma in me. "A man is but a product of his thoughts. What he thinks, he becomes." — MK Gandhi. Gandhi was a firm believer in the power of thoughts to change one's life and destiny. Exhibited in Australia, Mumbai, and Zimbabwe.
- [A Legendary Smile](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/a-legendary-smile): A Legendary Smile — Mahatma in me. "One must be able to love the meanest of creation as oneself." — MK Gandhi. Gandhi's legendary childlike smile was innocent, non-judgemental, and full of compassion, earning him the reputation of the Smiling Saint. Exhibited in India, Australia, and Africa.
- [Autumn](https://vibhorsogani.com/installations/autumn): Autumn, a wall art installation.
